Explain in your own words what 'Stabilisation vs Structural Reforms' refers to.
questions.a: The classification of economic reforms into short-term stabilization policies to handle immediate balance of payments and inflation crises, and long-term structural reforms to improve overall economic efficiency.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Stabilisation vs Structural Reforms'.
questions.a: Stabilisation manages immediate financial crises, while structural reforms restructure the economy for long-term growth.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Stabilisation vs Structural Reforms' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.2 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.2)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Deregulation of Industrial Sector' refers to.
questions.a: The dismantling of regulatory barriers such as industrial licensing, public sector monopoly reservations, and price controls to allow free entry and operation of private firms.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Deregulation of Industrial Sector'.
questions.a: Abolishing licensing and opening up reserved sectors to allow market forces to determine production and pricing.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Deregulation of Industrial Sector' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.3 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.3 (Deregulation of Industrial Sector))

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Financial Sector Reforms' refers to.
questions.a: Policy measures designed to transition the role of the central bank from a rigid regulator to a facilitator, encouraging competition through private and foreign bank participation.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Financial Sector Reforms'.
questions.a: Reducing central bank control over interest rates, branch expansion, and lending to encourage private and foreign investment.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Financial Sector Reforms' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.3 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.3 (Financial Sector Reforms))

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Tax Reforms and Fiscal Policy' refers to.
questions.a: Reforms concerning government taxation and public expenditure policies, aimed at lowering tax rates, simplifying procedures, and introducing unified taxes like GST to improve compliance.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Tax Reforms and Fiscal Policy'.
questions.a: Lowering direct tax rates to encourage voluntary disclosure and compliance, and simplifying indirect taxes (like introducing GST).

questions.q: Under which section is 'Tax Reforms and Fiscal Policy' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.3 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.3 (Tax Reforms))

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Foreign Exchange Reforms and Devaluation' refers to.
questions.a: The deliberate reduction in the value of the domestic currency relative to foreign currencies to stimulate exports and transition to a market-determined exchange rate system.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Foreign Exchange Reforms and Devaluation'.
questions.a: Devaluation of the rupee in 1991 to boost exports and foreign exchange inflows, followed by freeing the exchange rate to market forces.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Foreign Exchange Reforms and Devaluation' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.3 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.3 (Foreign Exchange Reforms))

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Trade and Investment Policy Reforms' refers to.
questions.a: The removal of quantitative restrictions on imports and exports, reduction of import tariffs, and dismantling of import licensing to enhance domestic industrial competitiveness.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Trade and Investment Policy Reforms'.
questions.a: Removing protectionist trade barriers to increase local industrial efficiency and competitiveness.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Trade and Investment Policy Reforms' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.3 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.3 (Trade and Investment Policy Reforms))

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Privatisation and Disinvestment' refers to.
questions.a: The process of reducing government ownership or management in public sector enterprises, either by outright sale or by selling a portion of equity to the public (disinvestment).

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Privatisation and Disinvestment'.
questions.a: Shedding government ownership in public enterprises to improve financial discipline, modernize management, and attract private capital.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Privatisation and Disinvestment' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.4 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.4)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Globalisation and Outsourcing' refers to.
questions.a: The integration of a country's economy with the global economy, characterized by outsourcing business operations to external nations where skilled labor is available at lower costs.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Globalisation and Outsourcing'.
questions.a: Creating a borderless world through communication technology, where companies hire external services (like BPOs) from other nations.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Globalisation and Outsourcing' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.5 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.5)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'World Trade Organisation (WTO) Role' refers to.
questions.a: An international trade organization established in 1995 to succeed GATT, aiming to establish a rule-based, non-discriminatory global trading regime by reducing tariffs and trade barriers.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'World Trade Organisation (WTO) Role'.
questions.a: Promoting free trade by removing tariff and non-tariff barriers and providing equal opportunities to all member nations.

questions.q: Under which section is 'World Trade Organisation (WTO) Role' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 3.5 (source: keec103.txt Section 3.5 (World Trade Organisation))
